Data.UnitTalk_ENG: A mighty fine morning to you, Captain!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 力が漲る、すばらしい朝だな！団長！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 真是个精力充沛的早晨啊，团长！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 真是個精力充沛的早晨啊，團長！
Data.UnitTalk_THA: อรุณสวัสดิ์ กัปตัน!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Uh... You seem to be in a good mood.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: えっ…すごく元気そうだね？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 哦…妳看起来精神很好呢？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 哦…妳看起來精神很好呢？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: อืม… ดูดีขึ้นไหม?

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Ufufu! So even you can tell.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: オーッホッホ！団長の目にもそう映るか。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 唔—呼呼呼！连团长也看得出来啊。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 唔—呼呼呼！連團長也看得出來啊。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Hé hé hé ! Le capitaine me voit.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Wu-hu-hu! Kapitän, deine Augen sind zu sehen.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Uau! Até o capitão consegue ver isso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: อุ๊บส์! กัปตันมองเห็นแล้ว.
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Hoo-hoo-hoo! Aku bisa melihatnya di mata Kapten.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Ư-ừm! Đội trưởng cũng thấy rồi đó.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Did you have a good dream or something?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 昨夜はいい夢でも見たの？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: As-tu rêvé de moi hier soir ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Auch wenn es ein guter Traum ist, solltest du ihn träumen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: ¿Incluso un buen sueño es una pesadilla?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Mesmo em um sonho, você pode sonhar?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ฝันดีนะ กัปตัน?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ngay cả trong mơ cũng không dám mơ tới?

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Quite the opposite! I did not dream at all!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: いや、その逆さ！夢をひとつも見なかったのだよ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 正好相反！我一个梦都没做！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 正好相反！我一個夢都沒做！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Au contraire ! Je n'ai jamais rêvé !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Gegenteil! Kein Traum ist zu groß!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡Al revés! Ni siquiera he soñado nada.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Pelo contrário! Eu não tenho nenhum sonho!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ตรงกันข้าม! ฉันไม่เคยฝันเลย!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Trái lại! Tôi chưa từng mơ thấy điều đó!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 이 정도로 푹 잔 건 10년 만이군!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I haven't slept this soundly in ten years!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: これほどぐっすり眠れたのは、実に10年ぶりだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 像这样睡得这么沉，可是这十年以来头一遭啊！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 像這樣睡得這麼沉，可是這十年以來頭一遭啊！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: À ce rythme, je ne serai pas là dans 10 ans !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nur mit diesem Betrag, es sind bereits 10 Jahre!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡Con solo esto, ya son 10 años soñando!
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Com essa quantidade, é só um sonho de 10 anos!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แค่นี้ก็ 10 ปีแล้ว!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Hanya sampai sejauh ini, aku akan tidur selama 10 tahun!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Với tình hình này, chắc phải 10 năm nữa!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그렇다네! 여정을 시작하고 행운이 우리와 함께하는군!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Indeed! Fortune has been with us ever since we embarked on this Journey!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: そのとおり！旅が始まり、ついに幸運が我らに微笑み始めたのだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 就是！踏上旅程后，好运似乎一直与我们同在呢！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 就是！踏上旅程後，好運似乎一直與我們同在呢！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: C'est ça ! La jeune fille commence et le groupe qui l'accompagne est avec nous !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Na los! Beginne die Reise und sei mit uns glücklich!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: ¡Vaya! Empieza la era de la suerte y la fortuna juntas.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Ora! Comece sua jornada e a sorte nos acompanha!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ไม่นะ! เริ่มต้นการเดินทางที่โชคชะตาของเราจะมาพบกัน!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Benar! Mulai sekarang, kita akan bersama-sama meraih keberuntungan!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Đúng vậy! Nữ hoàng và chúng ta cùng nhau bắt đầu cuộc hành trình may mắn!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 어서 가세, 단장. 오늘 이 행운을 움켜쥐어야 하지 않겠나!
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Come, Captain. We must seize today's good fortune while we can!
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: さあ行こう、団長！今日という幸運を、この手で掴まねばなるまい！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 快走吧，团长。今天可得好好抓住这份幸运才行啊！
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 快走吧，團長。今天可得好好抓住這份幸運才行啊！
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Viens ici, commandant. Tu ne peux pas laisser ce bonheur t'échapper aujourd'hui !
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Komm schon, Captain. Du musst heute das Glück aufdecken!
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Adelante, mi señor. Hoy debemos deshacernos de esta mala suerte.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Venha cá, meu capitão. Hoje a sorte tem que ser virada!
Data.UnitTalk_THA: มานี่สิ ท่านผู้ใหญ่ วันนี้ต้องทำให้โชคชะตานี้สิ้นสุดลง!
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Ayo pergi, Kapten. Hari ini, kita harus mengukir keberuntungan kita sendiri!
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Vào đây, Đại nhân. Hôm nay, chúng ta phải nắm bắt vận may này!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 만족스러운 휴식 덕분인지 크리스텔은 의욕이 넘쳐 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Cristelle seemed eager to get going after such a good rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: しっかりと休息を取れたおかげか、クリステルはやる気に満ちあふれている。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 或许是多亏了令人满意的休息，克莉丝特看起来干劲十足。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 或許是多虧了令人滿意的休息，克莉絲特看起來幹勁十足。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Grâce à une bonne récupération, Cristal semble très enthousiaste.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Dank des angenehmen Schlafs wirkt Kristall sehr motiviert.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Parece que el descanso ha sido satisfactorio, y Cristal muestra una gran energía.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Parece que o cristal está cheio de energia devido ao descanso.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: คริสตัลที่เต็มไปด้วยความสุขนี้ บ่งบอกถึงความอุดมสมบูรณ์ที่เกินคาด
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Karena istirahat yang memuaskan, Kristal tampak sangat bersemangat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Vì có một giấc ngủ ngon, Kristel dường như đầy nhiệt huyết.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 그녀의 말대로 오늘 훈련에는 행운이 따를 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Perhaps Cristelle was right. It felt like luck would be on our side during today's training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 彼女の言う通り、今日のトレーニングは幸運が味方してくれそうだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 正如她所说，今天的训练似乎会有好运降临。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 正如她所說，今天的訓練似乎會有好運降臨。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Selon ce que vous avez dit, l'entraînement d'aujourd'hui sera chanceux.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Wie du sagst, heute scheint das Glück dich zu begleiten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Siguiendo tus palabras, el entrenamiento de hoy parece tener suerte.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Pela sua fala, o treino de hoje parece ter sorte.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ตามคำพูดของท่าน วันนี้การฝึกฝนก็เหมือนโชคชะตาที่ตามมา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Pelatihanmu hari ini tampaknya membawa keberuntungan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Theo lời người, hôm nay việc huấn luyện có vẻ may mắn.
